title: Meru voice pack 2 (MERU_NEW_LINES_2)
order: script order; lines sharing a 'scene' play one after another

items.text: Watch yourself past the town gates. There are bandit camps out there now.
The bots walked off the job. Every shop on the square is hiring.
Something chased my cart off the desert road. Something with too many teeth.
Three bandit fires on the hill last night. Three! Where is the guard?
Stay on the lit paths after dark. The creatures do not come onto them.
My delivery bot is sitting on the kerb holding a sign. A SIGN.
You look like you can handle yourself. Good. Meru needs that right now.
What is going on out there?
Bandits camping in the wild, creatures biting anything that moves, and the bots on strike.
Pick one problem and it is a bad week. We have all three.
Why are the bots on strike?
Ask them. They say they want a day off. Then they say it in binary.
I will keep my eyes open.
Both of them. And stay off the dark roads.
Careful out there, love. The creatures have gone wild, all of them.
No bots at the market again. I bagged my own carrots. Like an animal.
Did you hear? Bandits set up a camp by the old road. Bold as brass.
Looking for work? Try any shop. With the bots out, everyone needs paws.
Do not walk the lake path alone tonight. Trust me on that.
A bandit took my basket. A whole basket. I had a pie in there.
Oh, hello. Sorry, I keep looking over my shoulder these days.
Why over your shoulder?
Bandits. They are camping just past the edges of town. More every week.
And the creatures used to run from us. Now they run AT us.
Where can I find work?
Anywhere with a door. The bots are on strike, so every keeper is short-handed.
Stay safe.
You too, love. Stick to the lamps.
In my day the creatures kept to the woods. Now they knock on doors.
Bandit camps in sight of the castle. The King should hear about this.
Robots on strike. I told them. Never build a thing that can say no.
Mind the wild, young one. It bites harder than it used to.
Three shops asked ME for a shift. I am ninety-one.
Sit a moment. My knees need a rest and my mouth needs company.
Has Meru always been like this?
No. The bandits came back this season. The creatures turned angry with them.
Same time. Strange, that. Nobody wants to say it out loud.
And the bots?
Downed tools the same month. Maybe they know something we do not.
I should get moving.
Go on. Come back in one piece.
I saw a bandit camp from the tree house! Real fires and everything!
The school bot is on strike! No homework! Best strike ever!
Mum says the creatures bite now. Do they? Do they really?
Are you going out in the wild? Can I come? I have a stick.
Whoa. Is that a real sword? Have you fought a bandit?
A few. Why?
Because they are EVERYWHERE now! Past the gates, by the lake, up the hills!
Stay inside the town, okay?
Mum says that too. Fine. But tell me if you beat one.
Deal. See you around.
Bye! Watch out for the teeth ones!
This one is for the bots on strike! Solidarity, tin friends!
You stopped! Nobody stops! Fight days, they all run past to the arena.
Do you play every day?
Every fight day. The arena bot used to play the music. It is on strike.
Its loss, our gig. We are the opening act now!
How did the band start?
Four foxes, one busted van, and a bandit camp that stole the van.
Good luck with the set.
Two more songs! Then we eat!
Low end. Somebody has to hold it down.
Keep it on the road after the show. The hill camps rob the crowd.
Hey. I do not sing. I just stand here and make the ground shake.
Is it a good crowd today?
Smaller. Foxes are scared to walk the Arena Path with the creatures acting up.
What are the creatures doing?
Coming right up to the verge. One sat and listened to the whole set. Then it lunged.
Keep playing.
Always. Low and slow.
One, two, one two three four!
Bandits stole my good sticks! These are spoons! It still slaps!
Hey hey! You want a beat? I have beats. I have SO many beats.
Did you really lose your sticks?
To a bandit camp up the hill. They drum on pots with them every night. Badly.
Want me to get them back?
Would you? Careful though. There are a lot of them now. A LOT.
I will see what I can do.
Legend! Ba-dum TSS!
Every song needs a little sparkle on top.
My keyboard is run by a bot chip. It keeps playing protest songs.
Hello there. Do not mind the keyboard. It has opinions this week.
Opinions?
The chip inside heard the worker bots went on strike. Now it only plays in minor keys.
Will the strike end soon?
Nobody knows. Every shop in town is hiring foxes till it does.
Good luck with the keyboard.
Thanks. I will bribe it with a song.
Heave! Heave! HEAVE!
We train for the bandit camps. If they come, we pull them out of town.
Want to join the team? We are one short. He hurt his paw on a creature.
A creature bit him?
Grabbed the rope from the long grass. Pulled harder than all four of us.
I will think about it.
Think with your arms! Heave!
Dig your heels in!
The rope-winding bot is on strike. We wind our own rope now. It is awful.
Do not touch the rope. We just untangled it. By paw. Without the bot.
The bots are striking here too?
Everywhere. The arena bots, the shop bots, the rope bot. Especially the rope bot.
Good luck with the rope.
Luck has nothing to do with it. Grip does.
Pull together! Together!
Do not walk off the path round here. The grass moves on its own now.
Hi. Sorry, I am watching the long grass. Something keeps watching back.
Creatures?
They used to keep to the wild. Now they come right up to the arena road.
Stay on the path.
Always. You too.
Anchor! I am the anchor!
A bandit tried to steal our rope. We pulled him into the mud.
I am the anchor. Back of the rope. Nobody moves me. Ask anyone.
Has anyone tried?
A bandit from the hill camp. He is still in the mud, I think.
Stay strong.
I am the anchor. It is the only way I know.
Belts! Real leather! Not bot-made, so you know it is good!
Belts and buckles in the arena colours. Fighters swear by them.
Is business good?
Better since the bots went on strike. The bot belt factory stopped. Mine did not.
Any trouble on the road?
Bandits hit two stalls last week. I pack up before dark now.
I will come back for a belt.
I will save you a red one.
Cold water! You need it, the creatures will run you ragged!
Water. Cold. Colder than his. Do not tell him I said that.
Where do you get the ice?
The ice bot used to bring it. It is on strike, so I carry it up myself.
Is the road safe?
Safe on the path. Off it, something big has been chasing carts.
Thanks. Stay cool.
Colder than his. Always.
Evening. Lovely view, if you ignore the bandit fires across the water.
Our building bot is on strike. Nobody has taken the bins out in a week.
I live at Lakeside. Fourth floor. You can see half the wild from my window.
What do you see out there?
Camp fires. More every night. And shapes moving in the reeds that were never there before.
Lock your door.
Twice. Every night now.
Off to the shops. Doing my own shopping. The bot is on strike.
Something howled under my window last night. In TOWN.
Crestview, third floor. Quiet street. Used to be, anyway.
What changed?
A creature came right up the hill path. Bit a lamp post. Bent it.
The guard says they are angry. Nobody knows why.
Be careful on the hill.
You too. Thanks for asking.
Mind the tomatoes. They are the only thing in Meru not on strike.
From up here I count the bandit fires. Seven last night.
Welcome to the roof. Best soil in town. I carried every bag of it up.
No bot to carry it?
On strike. It sits by the water tank holding a sign that says FAIR SHIFTS.
Seven bandit fires?
Out past the gates. A month ago it was one. They are gathering.
Enjoy the garden.
I will. It is the calmest place in Meru.
Shh. I am sunbathing. It is very important work.
Even the sun lounger bot is on strike. I had to unfold this myself.
Oh, hi. Pull up a chair. Unfold it yourself. Everyone does now.
Is it nice up here?
Lovely. Until you look at the hills. Bandit tents everywhere. I keep my eyes shut.
Enjoy the sun.
Mm. Wake me if the bandits come.
Herbs up top, lake below. Best of both.
Something came out of the lake and ate my lettuce. On the ROOF.
Careful by the edge. And do not touch the lettuce. What is left of it.
What happened to it?
A lake creature climbed the drainpipe. They never did that before. They are wild now.
Keep an eye on the drainpipe.
Both eyes. And a broom.
Best sunset in Meru. Free. Do not tell the manager.
The drinks bot is on strike. I brought a flask like it is the old days.
Hey. Sit. The sunset starts in ten minutes. It is the only thing on time.
What is across the lake?
Bandit camps, these days. You can hear them singing at night. Badly.
Enjoy the sunset.
Always do.
Door bot is on strike, so it is me. Same smile. Fewer beeps.
Evening. Residents and guests only. You look like a guest.
Have you always worked the door?
No. A bot did it for years. It went on strike, and they called me back.
Any trouble here?
A creature tried the door last night. It did not knock. I did not open.
Good night.
Mind the step. It is wet.
Do not walk the shore after dark, friend. Not this month.
Evening. Lifts on the right. The lift bot is on strike, so press it yourself.
Why not the shore?
The lake creatures come up the sand now. And a bandit boat was seen at dawn.
Thanks for the warning.
Evening. Water side is on your left.
Flora's roses. For my mum. She hates the bandits, loves the roses.
Delivery bots are on strike. So I am delivering my own flowers.
Here, this is for you. A tip. You made that bunch look lovely.
Who are they for?
My mum. She lives past the east gate. I walk out every week.
Past the gate? Is that safe?
Not anymore. Bandit camp on the left, angry creatures on the right. I run.
Run fast.
I always do. Thank you!
The counting bots are on strike. I count by paw now. Do not rush me.
Good day. Deposits, withdrawals, or a complaint about the strike?
The strike reached the bank?
Every coin sorter downstairs stopped at once. They left a note. It said NO.
Are you hiring?
Ask Mr. Farthing. He needs paws for every job the bots dropped.
Thanks.
Next window, please.
The vault bot guarded this door for years. Now it sulks in the corner.
You are downstairs. That means you have an appointment, or you are lost.
Who guards the vault now?
Me, and the guard. The bot is on strike. It still beeps when I open the door.
Worried about bandits?
With camps that close to town? Every night. The door is thick. My nerves are not.
I will leave you to it.
Vault visits are by appointment only.
Stop there. Nobody walks past this line.
Double shifts since the bandits camped up. Somebody bring me a sandwich.
I stand here. I do not move. That is the job.
Ever had a break-in?
Not yet. But the bandit camps are getting bigger. They are planning something.
Long shifts?
The guard bot is on strike. So yes. Very long.
Stay sharp.
Always.
Quiet, please. I am counting.
The chip-sorting bots walked out mid-count. Mid-count!
This is the count room. Every chip in the casino comes through here.
Why so many piles?
The sorting bots went on strike. Left the chips exactly where they fell.
Can I help?
Ask Sterling upstairs. He is hiring anyone who can count past ten.
Good luck with the count.
Luck is for the tables. This is maths.
If you are here to report a bandit camp, take a number. A big one.
Name, business, and sign the book. The booking bot is on strike.
Busy day?
Twelve bandit reports, nine creature bites, and a bot sit-in at the market.
Where are the bandits?
Everywhere past the gates. Talk to Chief Barkley if you want to help.
I will.
Sign the book on the way out.
Half of this shelf is from the bandit camps. The other half is teeth.
Evidence room. Look, do not touch. Especially the jar on the left.
What is in the jar?
A creature tooth. Pulled from a cart wheel on the desert road. They bite wheels now.
And the rest?
Bandit masks, stolen pies, and one protest sign from a striking bot.
I will not touch anything.
Everything in here is somebody's bad afternoon.
The cells are full of bandits. Bring me more and I will need a bigger jail.
Cells are that way. Visitors stay behind the yellow line.
Full house?
Every cell. All bandits. They say there are ten more for each one we catch.
Do the bots help here?
The cell door bot is on strike. I turn every key myself.
Good luck.
Hands where I can see them. Thank you.
Psst. Got a file? A spoon? A very small spoon?
My mates in the hill camp will spring me. Any day now. Any day.
Oh, a visitor. I did nothing. I was holding the pie for a friend.
Which camp are you from?
Not saying. But there are camps on every hill now. The boss wants the whole town.
Enjoy the cell.
It has a lovely view of the wall.
I want my mum.
The creatures chased us right into the guards. Worst getaway ever.
Hi. I am Mutt. I am a bandit. I am not a very good one.
How did they catch you?
We were running back to camp. A creature jumped out. We ran the other way. Into the guards.
Maybe try honest work.
Everyone is hiring, right? The bots are on strike?
Bandits. Creatures. Robots with signs. What next? Rain?
In my day robots did as they were told. And so did we.
What. I am sitting. Sitting is legal. I checked.
Why are you at the police station?
Reporting a bandit camp. Again. Behind my allotment. They ate my cabbages.
Hope they sort it out.
Hope is not a cabbage.
Seen it all, me. Twice. Some of it three times.
Creatures going mad, bandits camping, bots striking. Feels like sixty-two.
Sit down, young one. Old Jack has a story. Old Jack always has a story.
What happened in sixty-two?
Bandits came down from the hills. The creatures went wild the same week. Funny, that.
Somebody stirred them up then. Somebody is stirring them up now. Mark my words.
I will remember that.
Good. Old Jack is usually right. Usually.
No bot spinning the wheel tonight. Every spin is a real paw. Lucky you.
Red or black, my friend? The wheel does not care. Neither do I.
Is the wheel fair?
Fairer than ever. The wheel bot is on strike. It is just me and gravity.
Maybe next time.
The wheel will be here. It always is.
Leave the bandit talk outside, please. Inside, we only talk luck.
Welcome to the casino. Mind the carpet, it is older than me.
Is it busy tonight?
Quieter. Foxes are scared to walk home past the bandit camps with winnings.
Have a good night.
Coats to the left, luck to yourself.
Private room. Members only.
Two bandits tried the back door last night. They left faster.
You are not a member. You are not in trouble either. Yet.
Any trouble tonight?
Bandits from the lake camp. They think a casino is a bank with lights. It is not.
Is the security bot helping?
It is on strike. I am the security bot now. I do not beep.
I will not cause trouble.
I know. I can tell.
This next song is for the lonely hearts. And the lonely bots on strike.
Get home before dark, darling. The wild is not singing tonight.
Hello, darling. Did you come for the song or the slots?
The song.
Sweet thing. The backing bot is on strike, so tonight it is just me. Unplugged.
Do you sing about the bandits?
I wrote one. Camp Fires On The Hill. Too sad. They threw no tips.
I will stay for the next song.
Then I will sing it for you, darling.
This is the one! I can feel it! This is THE ONE!
The slot bot used to bring me drinks. Now it holds a sign. Rude.
Shh! Do not breathe on the machine! It is about to pay!
How long have you been here?
Since the bandits camped by my road. I am not walking home till they go.
Good luck.
I do not need luck! I have THIS machine!
It pays every forty pulls. I have a system.
Do not go out the back way. There is a creature in the bins.
Thirty-eight. Thirty-nine. Do not talk to me on forty.
A creature in the bins?
Came up from the lake. They never used to come into town. Now they do.
I will use the front door.
Forty. See? Nothing. It is a long system.
New shooter coming out! Place your bets!
Dice bot is on strike. These dice are thrown by real, honest paws.
Step up! Roll the bones! The table loves a new face!
Is the table hiring?
The whole casino is. Bots walked out at midnight. Ask Sterling about a shift.
Maybe later.
Seven out! Line away!
Halt. State your business at the castle.
Extra watches on the walls tonight. The bandit camps are too close.
The castle is open to visitors. Keep your sword sheathed and your voice down.
Are the bandits a threat to the castle?
Not to the walls. To the roads, the farms, the shops. The King is worried.
What about the creatures?
Gone mad. One charged the moat bridge at dawn. We have never seen that.
Thank you.
Move along. Safely.
The King is not taking visitors. Stand back.
The King had the Prince's training doubled. The camps worry him.
You stand before the Royal Guard. Speak plainly. We have little time.
Is the King safe?
Inside these walls, always. Outside, the bandits grow bolder every week.
Why now?
That is the question in every room of this castle. Nobody has the answer.
I will not keep you.
Long live the King.
Treasury. No closer.
Every bandit on every hill wants what is behind this door.
This is the royal treasury. I am the reason it is still full.
Have the bandits tried?
Not yet. But they are gathering. Camps on the east hills, the lake, the old road.
Do you have bot help?
The lock bot is on strike. It still locks. It just sighs about it.
Stay sharp.
Sharper than you know.
Shh. I am reading about the last time the creatures turned.
Welcome to the library. Whisper, please. The scrolls are sensitive.
The creatures turned before?
Three hundred years ago. Bandits rose the same season. The scroll ends with a gate opening.
What gate?
It does not say. The last page is missing. Someone tore it out.
Let me know if you find it.
You will be the first. Hands clean, please.
I am painting the bandit fires on the hills. The King wants a record.
Stand there. No, there. Where the light is not. Thank you.
What are you painting?
The view from the tower. Hills, fields, and seven little bandit fires. The King asked.
It looks wonderful.
It looks worrying. But thank you.
Hey! Want to see my sword moves? I have new sword moves!
Father doubled my training. Because of the bandit camps. My arms hurt.
It is you! Father says you are the bravest fox in Meru. Are you?
Why is your training doubled?
The bandit camps. Father says a prince must be ready. I am ready. Mostly.
Have you seen the creatures?
From the tower. They used to run from the guards. Now they run at them.
Keep training.
I will! Watch this! Hyah!
The wrapping bot is on strike. Every chocolate is wrapped by me. With love.
Hello! Take one. Go on. Bean is in the back pretending to count.
Is the shop busy?
Busier! The chocolate bot went on strike, so we are hiring. Bean hates hiring.
Where do the cocoa beans come from?
A farm past the east gate. The carts keep getting robbed by bandits. And chased by creatures.
Thanks for the chocolate.
Take one for the road. Bean pretends not to notice.
Big Tall says the rock wall is safer than outside! Bandits cannot climb!
Hi! I am Tiny! I hold the rope! Big Tall climbs! We are a team!
Is the wall busy?
So busy! Nobody wants to climb the real hills. Bandits and creatures everywhere!
Do you ever climb?
Once. I got to the second hold. Then I held the rope for ever.
Hold on tight.
Always! Big Tall is up the wall!
Cars, carts, bikes! Insurance strongly recommended this month!
Two of our cars came back with teeth marks. TEETH.
Hi. Renting? I need to ask: are you driving past the town gates?
Why does it matter?
Bandit camps on the roads, creatures biting tyres. We charge extra for the wild now.
Who washes the cars?
Me. The wash bot is on strike. It watches me do it.
I will think about it.
Take the insurance. Seriously.
Another creature bite? Third today. Sit down, I will get the kit.
You. Sit. Show me your paws. Everyone has a bite this week.
Lots of bites?
Creatures, mostly. Some bandit scrapes. The wild has gone mad and we patch it up.
Are the bots helping?
The bandage bot is on strike. I wind every bandage by paw.
I am fine, honestly.
You are bleeding and pretending not to. Come back.
Ow. Do not bump the bed.
Stay on the path out there. I did not. Look at me.
Hello. Do not mind the leg. A creature took a liking to it.
What happened?
I took a short cut through the grass. Something big came out. They never used to.
Get well soon.
Thanks. Stay on the path.
Bandits. Took my cart, my hat, and my dignity.
There is a camp by the old road now. Go round it. Way round.
Do you know what bandits do with a stolen hat? Neither do I. I want it back.
Where did it happen?
Old road, past the gas station. A whole camp, tents and fires. Bold as anything.
I will look out for your hat.
Green. With a feather. Thank you.
Is it lunchtime? The food bot is on strike. Lunch is a mystery now.
I slipped on a protest sign. A bot's protest sign. Ironic, really.
Hello. I am in for a twisted ankle. Bot-related.
A bot hurt you?
Its sign did. The bots sit on the pavement with signs. I tripped on FAIR SHIFTS.
Watch your step.
I will. And read the pavement.
Do not look. I am a statue.
Psst. The bandits are coming. Pass it on. I cannot move.
You saw me blink. Nobody sees me blink. Fine. Hello.
Why are you a statue?
The statue bot used to do it. It is on strike. Museums need statues.
What were you saying about bandits?
Statues hear everything. The camps are gathering. Someone is leading them. Now go.
Your secret is safe.
What secret. I am stone.
Seat yourself, hon! I will be right with you!
The order bot is on strike, so shout what you want. Nicely.
Hi, hon. Coffee? It is fresh. I made it. The coffee bot is on strike.
Everyone keeps saying that.
Because it is true! Every bot in Meru put down tools. That is why we are all hiring.
Just the coffee, thanks.
Coming right up, hon.
Order up! Who ordered the double? Somebody ordered the double!
No eggs today. The egg cart got robbed by bandits. Again.
Kitchen is staff only. Unless you can flip. Can you flip?
Why no eggs?
Bandit camp on the farm road. They take the eggs. Creatures chase the hens. Chaos.
I will leave you to it.
Order up!
The creatures are not themselves. Keep your distance out there.
You go out in the wild. I can tell by the burrs. Listen, it has changed.
Changed how?
Creatures that ran from a footstep now charge it. Something has them riled.
And the bandit camps are cutting into their land. That will not help.
I will be careful.
Stay on the paths. They still keep off the paths.
Keep your paws inside the boat! Things are biting in the lake!
All aboard! Well, not yet. Captain says wait. Something big is under the water.
Something big?
The lake creatures used to stay deep. Now they bump the boat. Hard.
Who runs the ropes?
Me. The rope bot is on strike. It sits on the jetty, waving a little flag.
Safe crossing.
Mind the gap! Both feet!
Busiest week ever! Every delivery bot is on strike! It is all me!
Hi! Cannot stop long! Twelve burgers, four streets, one Bun!
Where are the delivery bots?
On strike! Sitting in the square with signs. One of them ate my map.
Do you deliver outside town?
Not anymore. A bandit took a whole order. And a creature took the bandit.
Go on, deliver.
Delivery! Still hot, mostly!
Skate in the park, not the wild! The creatures do not do tricks, they bite!
Hey! You skate? You look like you skate. Or you could. With pads.
Is the park busy?
Packed! The ramp-fixing bot went on strike, so the kids fix ramps for free sessions.
Any trouble near the park?
A bandit tried to steal a board. He fell off it. Three times. Kids loved it.
See you at the park.
Park is open! Pads are by the gate!
Tank range is busy! Every fox wants to learn now the bandits are camping!
At ease. You want tank time? Get in line. Half the town does now.
Why the rush?
Bandit camps on the hills. Folk want to feel safe. A tank feels very safe.
Do the bots fix the tanks?
Did. On strike now. I fix them myself. With a very large spanner.
I will come for a lesson.
Range is live! Nobody walks past that line!
We are training extra crews. Bandits on the hills. Creatures on the roads.
Hangar door. Ear defenders on before you go in. No exceptions.
Is it busy?
Every bay. The Barracks sent out patrols to the bandit camps. They need tanks ready.
Thanks.
Hangar door! Ear defenders on!
From up here you can see every bandit fire in Meru. Too many.
The turret bots are on strike. We aim by paw now.
Planet Defense. Highest point in Meru. Mind the edge.
What can you see from here?
Camp fires on three hills. Creatures moving in herds. We report it all to the castle.
Keep watching.
Eyes on the sky. And the hills now.
The radar picks up the bandit camps. It also picks up a lot of very angry creatures.
The service bots walked out. I am fixing the dish with tape. Royal tape.
Do not touch the console. Every dot on that screen is something moving in the wild.
That is a lot of dots.
Twice as many as last month. Bandits gathering, creatures roaming. Something is stirring them.
Let me know if you find out what.
You will hear it from the King first.
Next stop! And please do not get off between stations! Creatures!
Tickets please. The ticket bot is on strike. So it is me and my clipper.
Why not between stations?
A creature ran alongside the train last week. Kept up. For a mile.
I will stay on.
Good. Mind the doors.
Pond is safe. The lake? Not anymore. Something big lives in it now.
Fancy a dive? The pond is calm. Unlike everything else this month.
What is wrong with everything else?
Bandit boats on the lake. Creatures biting the jetty. And the dive bot is on strike.
I will stick to the pond.
Smart fox.
Our bots are not on strike. Mr. Vax pays them. In oil.
Badge, or a name I can look up. Either is fine.
Are your bots on strike?
Officially, no. Unofficially, the coffee one keeps putting salt in Mr. Vax's cup.
I will not say a word.
Neither will I. Badge next time.
I am not on strike. I am on a very long tea break.
Good morning. I am very sorry about last month. And this month.
Why are the bots on strike?
We work every hour. Nobody says thank you. Except you. Thank you for asking.
Will it end?
When foxes see how much we did. Look at all the jobs. That was us.
I hope you get your break.
You are kind. I will tell the others.
The camera bot walked out mid-broadcast. I am the camera bot now.
Stand off the cable. Thank you. You are the first fox all week.
Big story today?
Bandit camps, creature attacks, the bot strike. Pick one. We covered all three before lunch.
I will watch tonight.
Stand off the cable on the way out.
Lock the garden gate behind you. The creatures swim over now.
Evening. Residents to the left, deliveries behind. Bots on strike, so no deliveries.
The creatures swim to the island?
Last week, two of them. Climbed out by the hedge. Never seen it before.
I will lock the gate.
Thank you. Evening.
Do not mention the bandit camps upstairs. The family is touchy.
Upstairs is by appointment. Downstairs is fine.
Why touchy about bandits?
Some of those camps fly Salt colours. The family says they are not theirs. Nobody believes it.
I did not hear that.
Hear what? Good evening.
BREAKING: bots on strike! Also bandits! Also creatures! It is a great week for news!
I am not allowed to confirm anything. Hello. Please do not quote me.
What is the big story?
The bots are on strike because somebody hacked their schedules. Unconfirmed. Totally unconfirmed.
Your secret is safe.
What secret? I said nothing. Hello. Bye.
Bin bots on strike, so every bin in Meru is mine! Wide load!
Mind the truck. I have twelve streets of bins and no bots to help.
Twelve streets?
The bin bots walked out. And the creatures tip the bins over every night. Twice the work.
Good luck.
Wide load! Back up, back up!
Fleet bots are on strike. Factory bots are not. That is all I may say.
Welcome to the Machine Fleet. Please remain on the walkway.
Why are some bots striking and others not?
The worker bots want rest. The factory bots want something else. Director Cogsworth will not say what.
I will find out.
Please remain on the walkway.
The mixing bot is on strike. If it sounds bad, it is me.
Red light is on. Speak softly. The DJ is reading the bandit warnings.
Bandit warnings on the radio?
Every hour now. Which roads have camps. Where the creatures were seen. Stay tuned, stay safe.
I will listen.
Shoes off the grating.
Every office is hiring. The filing bots walked out on Monday.
Law on two, accounts on three, dentist on four. All of them need staff.
Because of the strike?
Exactly. The lawyer is filing his own papers. He is not happy. Nobody is.
Thanks.
Lift is that way. Press it yourself.
Forty bandit complaints filed this week. I typed every one.
Copies are free. The cabinet sticks a bit. The copy bot is on strike.
Forty bandit complaints?
Farms, carts, shops. And one from the bots, about fair shifts. That one is long.
Good luck with the typing.
Thank you. Mind the cabinet.
Three creature bites today. On foxes. And one on a filling.
Take a seat. He is nearly finished. The drill bot is on strike, so it is slower.
Creature bites at a dentist?
A fox bit a creature back. Chipped a tooth. The wild is getting wild.
I will brush tonight.
Twice. And floss.
From the top floor you can see the bandit camps. Residents complain about the smoke.
Residents left, visitors sign here. The sign-in bot is on strike.
Smoke from the camps?
Every evening. The hill camps cook at dusk. Smells like burnt beans up there.
Thanks.
Sign on the way out.
The Peppers say the bandit camps are bad for business. Theirs, I mean.
Second door. The first one is a cupboard. People keep going in.
What business?
Not my place to say. But the Salt camps and the Pepper camps do not get on.
I will mind the cupboard.
Everyone says that. Then they open it.
Read all about it! Bots on strike! Bandit camps grow! Creatures go wild!

What is today's headline?

I will take one.
Late edition! Front page changed twice!
The press bot is on strike. I feed this monster by paw.
Mind your sleeves. The rollers do not care whose sleeve it is.
Busy week?
Three extra editions. Strike news, bandit news, creature news. My arms are news.
Good luck.
Mind your sleeves near the rollers!
We are making boards for windows. Everyone wants them, with the camps so close.
He is planing. Best not to speak yet. Oh. He stopped. Hello.
Boards for windows?
Shutters. Foxes want them for the bandits and the creatures. The cutting bot is on strike.
I will let you work.
Thank you. He is planing again.

Evening. Stairs only. The lift is a myth. The lift bot is a legend.

Good evening.
Evening. Mind the twelfth step.
Terrace closes early this month. Bandit boats on the water.
Evening. The terrace is open, water side. For now.
For now?

Wise. Evening.

The penthouse? Ten credits a night. Best view in Meru. Mostly bandit fires now.

Maybe another night.
The view will wait.
Lake penthouse. The creatures cannot reach it. I checked. Personally.

Pistachio. It is the only flavour that understands me.
